minister.name: Esperance Luvindao
minister.role: Minister of Health and Social Services

snapshot.text: Two-tier system with public hospitals for most people and private care for the insured minority. Under the 'Vision April 2026' reform senior officials must use public hospitals, alongside investment in infrastructure, staff and emergency transport.

priorities.title: Vision April 2026
priorities.text: Officials must use public facilities, with a facility assessment and reforms to raise quality; the minister says it is too early to judge the impact.

priorities.title: Emergency transport
priorities.text: The ministry promised 60 ambulances over three years and in November 2026 launched the country's first State-owned air ambulance service for remote areas.

priorities.title: HIV prevention and access
priorities.text: Namibia registered the twice-yearly HIV prevention injection lenacapavir; the minister warns that access remains a concern because of its cost.

netherlands.text: Dutch organisations have a long health footprint: PharmAccess built low-income health insurance and mobile clinic partnerships with the ministry (2004-2016), and KNCV Tuberculosis Foundation has an office in Windhoek and supported the first national TB prevalence survey.

institutions.name: Ministry of Health and Social Services

timeline.text: Ministry promises 60 ambulances over three years.
Namport donates two ambulances to the ministry.
First State-owned air ambulance service launched.
